nonBlockingObservations.title: Pin the Instant sampling order in the clock-pair implementation
nonBlockingObservations.description: The lower-bound formula is sound for elapsed time from the fixed monotonic_before reference when its arming Instant is sampled after the successful observe_clock read, including that read's monotonic_after sample. The phrase "the Instant of the read" does not explicitly state the order. Sampling Instant before a slow clock observation would count part of that read both in lag and in the subsequent Instant delta, so exclusion of sleep alone would not prove the claimed lower bound.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: Carry an explicit code-unit rule that observe_clock completes before the arming Instant is sampled, and sample the determination Instant at the decision point after any failed read. Describe the lower bound relative to the fixed reference bracket, as LD-D3B-10 defines it. Add a deterministic delayed-arming-read control proving the read interval is not counted twice. No clock reset, new field or new successor is needed.
